title: feat(spec): a select option value may be one character (grade a / b / c publishes as written)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzSKmmnBserc2pZuhqHqJhoYw)_

Fixes #37749

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：作者或智能体给下拉字段写「客户等级 A/B/C」这类选项时，存储值直接写 `a`、`b`、`c` 就能发布，不再被拒后改成 `level_a`。
- 为什么做：云端 agent 效果专题第二阶段（框架一行）；基线评测里这类首存 3 次全被拒，每个字段多一轮保存。
- 出错会怎样：只放宽选项值这一处，空值、大写、数字开头照旧拒绝；对象名、字段名等其它标识符的 2 字符下限不动，已存数据不受影响。
- 要你做什么：无（已在 cloud#5027 计划 v2 决定 3 里批了）。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:326` — new local `SelectOptionValueSchema`: the system-identifier character rule (`^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]*$`) with `.min(1)` instead of `.min(2)`. `SelectOptionSchema.value` (`field.zod.ts:405`) now uses it. `SystemIdentifierSchema` and `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema` are untouched.
- Every option-value check, and what happened to it (file:line on this head):

| Check | File:line | Change |
|---|---|---|
| Object-field option value | `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:405` | now `SelectOptionValueSchema` (floor 1) |
| Field `options` array | `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:2080` | inherits (reuses `SelectOptionSchema`) |
| Form-view option (`FormSelectOptionSchema`, #19678) | `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:4071` | inherits (spreads `SelectOptionSchema.shape`); pinned in the new tests |
| `defineForm` option-value remedy | `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:8371`, `:8381` | remedy text drops "a single character" (now spellable); `too_small` stays for the empty value |
| Picklist item / extension / field-level override | `packages/spec/src/data/picklist.zod.ts:77`, `:131`, `:158` | inherit |
| Field option display patch keyed by option value | `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:6374` | inherits (`optionShape.value`) |
| `Field.select` shorthand | `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:4320` | no change needed: `['A','B','C']` lower-cases to `a`,`b`,`c`, which now parse |
| Runtime select validation (data layer) | — | none exists: `objectql` / `core` check membership in the declared options, never length (grep in Acceptance notes) |
| Setup option editor client check | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx:2566` | only drops empty rows, no length check; comments at `:382`, `:2545` updated |
| Studio zh message for the grammar | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts:1002` | unchanged: keyed by the same pattern, text states no length |
| Generated | `content/docs/references/{data/field,data/picklist,ui/view}.mdx` | regenerated (`check:generated --fix`); authorable-surface shards did not move; JSON schema output is gitignored |
| Skills | `skills/**` | none states the 2-character floor (grep below), so no skill change |

- Pins that asserted the old floor, re-aimed at a value the spec still refuses (uppercase or empty), each keeping its original intent: `packages/spec/src/ui/form-option-enum-derive.test.ts`, `form-select-option.test.ts` (comment), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.resolved-picklist-options.test.ts`, `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/detail-view-field-options-10296.test.ts`, `select-option-tier1-convergence-7014.test.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/.../ObjectFieldInspector.{malformedOptions,optionKeyPreservation}.test.tsx`, `ui/e2e/live/studio-object-designer.spec.ts` (banner text regex).
- Docs: `content/docs/data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx:224`; checklist clause `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json:156` (banner text).
- `.changeset/37749-select-option-value-one-character.md`: `@objectstack/spec` **minor**.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/data/field.test.ts` › `select option value: one character is enough`: options `a`/`b`/`c` parse as option, field and object; `Field.select(['A','B','C'])` parses; the form-view face takes the floor; `''` (`too_small`), `A` and `1` (`invalid_format`) refused on option, form option and field (`options.0.value`); `SystemIdentifierSchema` / `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema` still refuse `'a'` with `too_small`.
- `packages/spec/src/data/picklist.test.ts` › `a one-character option value on a picklist`: picklist parses; `picklists.customer_grade.options.a` parses in `TranslationDataSchema` and resolves through `translatePicklist`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.select-shorthand-refusal.test.ts` › `a one-character option value saves at the object door`: `saveMetaItem` stores the object; `''` and `A` answer `422 INVALID_METADATA` at `fields.status.options.1.value` with `too_small` / `invalid_format`, nothing stored.
- Reverse check: with the floor put back to 2, 6 of the new spec tests turn red; restored from the commit.

## Acceptance notes

- Deviation: the card says "Changeset (spec patch)". A newly accepted value is `Metadata-protocol: added`, which `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`'s level axis grades `minor`, so the changeset is `minor`.
- No other identifier floor moved: `git diff origin/main -- packages/spec/src/shared` is empty; `git grep -n "\.min(" packages/spec/src/shared/identifiers.zod.ts` still shows `:104` and `:132` at `min(2`; the only `.min(` line this diff adds is the option value's `min(1`.
- Runtime length checks: `git grep` for `length < 2` / `.min(2` across `packages/{objectql,core,metadata,metadata-protocol,rest,lint,spec}/src` finds no option-value check; option values are matched by membership only.
- Skills: `git grep -i "2 char|two char|at least 2"` in `skills/` hits only an unrelated automation line.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` :: exit 0 (after `--fix` regenerated the reference docs)
- ui (repo root `ui/`): `vitest run` on the 4 touched ui test files :: 66 passed; `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` :: 5130 passed
- Derived gate families: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` :: exit 0 — 120 derived, 117 run at exit 0, 3 NOT-MEASURED (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: shallow clone; `spec check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: prerequisite exit 3, packages unbuilt in this worktree). `check:dts-closure` and `ui vitest scripts/` first read a half-built tree and were re-run at exit 0 after the closure build; `check:test-source-alias` asked the four edited test files for module-top `@objectstack/lint` / `@objectstack/formula` imports, added, re-run exit 0, those files re-run green (12 + 37)
